source.name: Niedax Group news, 10.06.2024: Niedax Group to become new Bayer 04 Leverkusen sleeve partner
source.quote: The contract runs until 30 June 2027, and the logo of the Niedax Group will be prominently displayed during Bundesliga matches and in any international competitions in which Bayer 04 take part over the next three years.

note: Value not disclosed. Partnership with the club dates to 1997; sleeve partnership since 2024/25 after Trive's contractual withdrawal.
